doc.description: Detects plants/weeds in the front camera and steers the drone away from them using GUIDED mode velocity setpoints.

define.name: PLANT_AVOIDER_CAMERA
define.description: Camera device (must match available simulator/airframe camera)

define.name: PLANT_AVOIDER_SHOW_MASK
define.description: Highlight detected green pixels in top half on camera feed (0/1)

define.name: PLANT_AVOIDER_SHOW_DETECTIONS
define.description: Draw detected plant bounding boxes on the camera feed (0/1)

define.name: PLANT_AVOIDER_SHOW_DEBUG_BOXES
define.description: Temporary debug: draw candidate/rejected boxes (yellow/blue) on camera feed (0/1)

define.name: PLANT_AVOIDER_LOG_DETECTIONS
define.description: Enable console logs for detections, boxes, and decisions (0/1)

define.name: PLANT_AVOIDER_LOG_EVERY_N_FRAMES
define.description: Log every N frames even if no detections (health heartbeat)

define.name: PLANT_AVOIDER_DEBUG_REJECTS
define.description: Temporary debug: log why candidate contours are rejected (0/1)

define.name: PLANT_AVOIDER_DEBUG_MAX_REJECT_LOGS
define.description: Temporary debug: max per-frame reject logs to avoid spam

define.name: PLANT_AVOIDER_STRAIGHT_BIAS
define.description: Fractional margin before a turn beats straight (0-1)

define.name: PLANT_AVOIDER_TURN_SPEED
define.description: Lateral body velocity used when turning (m/s)

makefile.raw: ap.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_USE_SIM_DARK_GREEN_HSV=0 ap.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_SHOW_MASK=0 ap.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_SHOW_DETECTIONS=0 ap.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_SHOW_DEBUG_BOXES=0 ap.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_LOG_DETECTIONS=0 ap.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_DEBUG_REJECTS=0

# Keep real-life YUV profile as default. nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_USE_SIM_DARK_GREEN_HSV=0 nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_SHOW_MASK=0 nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_SHOW_DETECTIONS=0 nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_SHOW_DEBUG_BOXES=0 nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_LOG_DETECTIONS=0 nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_DEBUG_REJECTS=0 # To test the simulator-specific dark-green profile later, use this instead: # nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_USE_SIM_DARK_GREEN_HSV=1 nps.CXXFLAGS += $(shell pkg-config --cflags opencv4 || pkg-config --cflags opencv) nps.LDFLAGS += $(shell pkg-config --libs opencv4 || pkg-config --libs opencv)
